description:
In `crates/gf2-core/src/field/expr.rs`, `gemm_matrixlike`, `gemm_trans_a_concrete_tiled` and the generic transposed-product arms are reported to return without writing `out` when the inner dimension is 0, although their contract says the output is overwritten; `Sum::evaluate_into` skips the `out` shape assertion on empty operands.

## Background

Reported by the field-matrix comment sweep.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A test reproduces the reported behavior at the cited location, or a record shows the report does not hold and the issue is rejected with that evidence.
- [hard] REQ-02: A product with inner dimension 0 writes the zero matrix to `out`; `evaluate_into` checks the output shape for every operand shape; tests cover dimensions 0 and 1.
title: Lazy field expressions skip writes and shape checks on empty operands
